---
title: "Prepare, approve and publish a one-off CVD report"
description: "Operate the controlled publication route for a completed bespoke analysis and PDF."
manual-review-status: not-reviewed
---

::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## Boundary and prerequisites

The bespoke analysis, reproducibility record and finished PDF are completed before this workflow. These controllers do not run, standardise or verify the analysis method. Retain analytical code, sources and review evidence in the approved private locations.

Choose a stable `study_id` matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`, for example `case_fatality_2025`. Use a positive integer version and an ISO report date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Titles and descriptions cannot contain double quotation marks.

## Optional disclosure screen {#disclosure-screen}

Menu: **User > BNR > Report utilities > Screen report counts for disclosure review**

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_disclosure_screen.do" INPUT_DTA REVIEW_ID [replace]
```

The input must contain `output_id`, `cell_id` and numeric `cell_count`. The screen flags counts 0–5, missing, negative or non-integer counts and duplicate identifiers. It writes private review outputs under `$BNR_STAGING/report_reviews/` and a log under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.

This is a screen, not disclosure control. It does not alter the input, apply secondary suppression, assess a whole report or approve publication.

## Step 1: prepare the candidate

Controller: `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s1_prepare.do`

Menu: **User > BNR > One-off CVD report publication > Step 1: Prepare one-off report candidate**

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s1_prepare.do" ///
    STUDY_ID REPORT_VERSION "C:\path\report.pdf" ///
    "Public report title" "Public description" YYYY-MM-DD [replace]
```

Step 1 requires a non-empty PDF, fingerprints it, copies it into the private candidate and creates `index.qmd` and `report.yml`. It does not inspect the PDF's analytical content.

```text
$BNR_STAGING/reports/cvd/studies/bnr_cvd_oneoff_STUDY_ID_vN/candidate/
  bnr_cvd_oneoff_STUDY_ID_vN.pdf
  index.qmd
  report.yml
```

Review the copied PDF and preview the landing page. Confirm the study ID, title, description, date, version, image, PDF link and disclosure safety. The private log is under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.

`replace` may rebuild an unapproved candidate. If that version is approved, prepare a higher version.

## Step 2: approve the candidate

Controller: `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s2_approve.do`

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s2_approve.do" ///
    STUDY_ID REPORT_VERSION "Full Name" "BNR Analyst" ///
    candidate disclosure ready
```

Only an authorised **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst** may approve. All three confirmations are required. The shared approval helper validates identity and version, copies the exact PDF, QMD and metadata into `public_ready`, writes a three-row `public_manifest.csv`, and writes `approval.yml` last. Approval is immutable and has no `replace` option.

Check the approved package under:

`$BNR_STAGING/reports/cvd/studies/bnr_cvd_oneoff_STUDY_ID_vN/public_ready/`

## Step 3: publish the report

Controller: `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s3_publish.do`

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_oneoff_s3_publish.do" STUDY_ID REPORT_VERSION [replace]
```

The shared publisher verifies the approval identity and authorised role, the manifest fingerprint and all three file fingerprints before copying.

| Product | Authoritative location | Website location |
|---|---|---|
| PDF | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/studies/STUDY_ID/bnr_cvd_oneoff_STUDY_ID.pdf` | `site/downloads/files/reports/cvd/studies/STUDY_ID/` |
| Landing page | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/studies/STUDY_ID/index.qmd` | `site/surveillance/cvd/reports/studies/STUDY_ID/index.qmd` |
| Metadata | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/studies/STUDY_ID/report.yml` | Website download folder |

Existing output requires `replace`. The publisher refuses a downgrade. Use a higher approved version for a correction; same-version replacement is only for controlled recovery.

After Step 3, run a complete Quarto render. Open the PDF and landing page, check both report listings and review all Git changes. The publication log is under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`.

Regression coverage is in `scripts/stata/reporting/tests/bnr_report_test_oneoff_lifecycle.do`; disclosure-screen coverage is in `bnr_report_test_disclosure_screen.do`.
